name: axHub sync
author: Brett
description: Keeps the console's look, settings and (if picked) data on axHub, so every app and device matches: same colour theme, layout and settings on web, Android and everywhere else. Built on the framework library lib-hubsync (framework/libs/hubsync). Settings → Plugins → axHub sync: connect to axHub (address, project, test, sign in), choose what syncs (look always / follow / off, settings, data all or some tables), status. The console already takes its look from axHub, so here it adds the settings and data.
